title: Transitivity of derived tensor products under base change
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $A$ and $B$ be commutative $R$-algebras, let $C$ be a commutative $(A\otimes_R B)$-algebra, let $E$ and $K$ be complexes of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and let $K'$ be a complex of $C$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. The canonical associativity and base-change isomorphisms in the derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] identify the two complexes $((E\otimes_A^L K)\otimes_R^L B)\otimes_{A\otimes_R B}^L C$ and $(E\otimes_A^L(K\otimes_R^L B))\otimes_{A\otimes_R B}^L C$, naturally in $E$, $K$, and $C$; under this identification, tensoring any morphism $K\otimes_R^L B\to K'$ by $E$ gives the corresponding morphism from the first complex to $E\otimes_A^L K'$ (with all tensor products derived over the displayed rings).
